info.name: digiField360.ai — Mobile Developer Real-Time API Collection
info.description:
🚀 **Official digiField360.ai Real-Time Mobile Developer Postman Collection**

This collection provides the complete, production-grade API suite for mobile developers (Flutter / React Native / iOS / Android) integrating with the **digiField360.ai Node.js Gateway & Live Salesforce Org**.

### 🌟 Core Highlights:
1. **Zero Hardcoded IDs (Dynamic Variable Chaining)**:
   - Login automatically populates `{{authToken}}` and `{{technicianId}}`.
   - Listing Work Orders dynamically extracts and sets `{{workOrderId}}`.
   - Creating records dynamically sets `{{recordId}}` and `{{accountId}}`.
   - Submitting parts requests dynamically sets `{{partsRequestId}}`.
   - Uploading photos/signatures dynamically sets `{{contentVersionId}}`.
2. **100% 24-Screen & Feature Coverage**:
   - Authentication, Morning Sync, Today's Jobs, State Machine Lifecycle, GPS Check-in & Geofencing, Activity Logs, Salesforce ContentVersion Photos & Signatures, Parts Catalogue & Requests, Customer/Asset Details, Completion Pipeline, GuruAI Diagnostic Chat, Attendance, Push Notifications, and Offline Queue Replay.
3. **Dual Execution Modes**:
   - **Live Salesforce Mode**: Communicates in real-time with Salesforce custom objects (`Work_Order__c`, `Technician__c`, `Job_History__c`, `ContentVersion`, `ContentDocumentLink`).
   - **Mock/Sandbox Mode**: Pass header `x-mock-mode: true` for zero-dependency offline UI development.
4. **Automated Smoke Test Assertions**: Built-in `pm.test` assertions for instant verification with Postman Collection Runner.
